glossary.name: Strength
glossary.text: 1% increased damage and healing per point with skills that scale with Strength. +3 max HP per point.

glossary.name: Agility
glossary.text: 1% increased damage and healing per point with skills that scale with Agility. +0.05% crit chance per point.

glossary.name: Magic
glossary.text: 1% increased damage and healing per point with skills that scale with Magic. +0.3 Ward per point.

glossary.name: Spirit
glossary.text: 1% increased damage and healing per point with skills that scale with Spirit. +1% status power per point. +0.25% chance per point to gain 1 extra Energy each turn.

glossary.name: Max HP
glossary.text: The HP of a fighter at full health. 100 at level 1, +10 a level, +3 per Strength.

glossary.name: Status
glossary.text: An effect on a fighter that lasts for turns or stacks up.

glossary.name: Dodge
glossary.text: A dodged hit deals no damage and puts no status on. Up to 40%.

glossary.name: Crit chance
glossary.text: Chance for a hit to be a critical hit. Every class has 5%, and each Agility point adds 0.05%. Increased crit chance adds up and raises that: 50% increased makes 10% into 15%. Each more crit chance multiplies the result. Up to 100%. A critical hit deals 50% more damage. Crit damage is increased damage for critical hits: it adds to your other increased damage. Reactions: Shatter.

glossary.name: Reaction
glossary.text: Two statuses on one fighter, or a status and a hit, set off a stronger effect.

glossary.name: Armor
glossary.text: Reduces physical damage taken by Armor / (Armor + 100). Up to 80%.

glossary.name: Ward
glossary.text: Reduces element damage taken by Ward / (Ward + 100). Up to 80%.

glossary.name: Block
glossary.text: A blocked hit deals 40% less damage. Block power raises the 40%. True damage cannot be blocked.

glossary.name: Energy
glossary.text: Skills cost Energy. +1 Energy at the start of each turn. +2 Energy from Focus. Up to 6 Energy, +1 per 20 Spirit.

glossary.name: Tenacity
glossary.text: Chance to resist each harmful status. Up to 60%.

glossary.name: Control resist
glossary.text: Chance to resist Asleep, Fear, Silence and Taunted. A boss has Tenacity plus 50%.

glossary.name: Soul Linked
glossary.text: Kept on Death. Goes to Storage on Wipe.

glossary.name: Untradable
glossary.text: Cannot be traded or sold on the Market.

glossary.name: Cosmetic
glossary.text: Goes in a vanity slot. No stats.

glossary.name: Signed
glossary.text: Signed by a maker of this game. Stays on the item through trades and the Market.

glossary.name: Kesbet
glossary.text: Raises an item's tier at a tier 3 Blacksmith. Drops from bosses and Tower chests. Salvaging a Legendary or Mythic item gives some.

glossary.name: Status power
glossary.text: Increased damage of the Burn, Poison and Bleed you put on enemies.

glossary.name: Element damage
glossary.text: Fire, frost, nature, holy and shadow damage. Ward reduces this damage.

glossary.name: True damage
glossary.text: Ignores Armor, Ward, resistances and block. Never a critical hit.

glossary.name: Crit damage
glossary.text: Increased damage for your critical hits. A critical hit deals 50% more damage. Crit damage adds to your other increased damage for that hit.

glossary.name: Increased
glossary.text: All increased and reduced add together. The same for the damage a fighter takes: Vulnerable, Shock, a weakness and a reaction add up.

glossary.name: More
glossary.text: Each more and less is a separate multiplier.

glossary.name: Melee
glossary.text: Uses the weapon in hand.

glossary.name: Projectile
glossary.text: Flies to the target.

glossary.name: Song
glossary.text: Played on the lute.

glossary.name: Warcry
glossary.text: Shouted at the enemy.

glossary.name: Area
glossary.text: Hits every enemy.

glossary.name: Allies
glossary.text: Affects every ally and you.

glossary.name: Ally
glossary.text: Affects one ally.

glossary.name: Self
glossary.text: Affects only you.

glossary.name: Combo
glossary.text: Uses a [status|status] already on the target.

glossary.name: Cooldown
glossary.text: Turns to wait before the next use.

glossary.name: Attack
glossary.text: Deals {1} physical damage. Scales with your class's main stat. Costs no Energy.

glossary.name: Focus
glossary.text: Gain 2 Energy instead of acting.

glossary.name: Lunge
glossary.text: Deals {1} physical damage. Scales with Strength. Cannot be dodged. The target gets Vulnerable for 2 turns. Costs 2 Energy.

glossary.name: Twin Cut
glossary.text: Hits twice. Each hit deals {1} physical damage. Scales with Agility. Each hit has a 50% chance to put 1 Bleed on the target. Costs 2 Energy.

glossary.name: Firebolt
glossary.text: Deals {1} fire damage. Scales with Magic. Puts 2 Burn on the target. Costs 2 Energy.

glossary.name: Impale
glossary.text: Deals {1} physical damage. Scales with Strength. The target gets Sunder for 2 turns. Costs 2 Energy.

glossary.name: Rousing Chord
glossary.text: You and every ally get Inspire for 2 turns. Costs 1 Energy. Once a round, a song for your allies does not end your turn.

glossary.name: Aimed Shot
glossary.text: Deals {1} physical damage. Scales with Agility. 75% more crit chance. Costs 2 Energy.

glossary.name: Pommel Strike
glossary.text: Deals {1} physical damage. Scales with Strength. A target with Vulnerable loses Vulnerable and gets 3 Daze. Any other target gets Vulnerable for 1 turn. Costs 1 Energy.

glossary.name: Deep Cut
glossary.text: Deals {1} physical damage. Scales with Agility. Doubles the target's Bleed, up to 10. Costs 1 Energy.

glossary.name: Hold the Line
glossary.text: Every enemy gets Taunted for 1 turn. Every enemy gets Fear for 1 turn. You get Fortify for 2 turns. Costs 2 Energy.

glossary.name: Pinning Shot
glossary.text: Deals {1} physical damage. Scales with Agility. A target with Slow loses Slow and gets 3 Daze. Any other target gets Slow for 2 turns. Costs 1 Energy.

glossary.name: Fire Wall
glossary.text: Every enemy gets Fire Wall for 3 turns. Costs 2 Energy.

glossary.name: Lullaby
glossary.text: The target gets Asleep for 3 turns. Costs 2 Energy.

glossary.name: Lunge Bite
glossary.text: Deals 9 physical damage. Scales with Strength. Puts 2 Bleed on the target.

glossary.name: Howl
glossary.text: Every wolf in the pack gets Inspire for 2 turns.

glossary.name: Gnaw
glossary.text: Hits twice. Each hit deals 4 physical damage. Scales with Strength. Each hit has a 50% chance to put 1 Bleed on the target.

glossary.name: Venom Bite
glossary.text: Deals 7 physical damage. Scales with Strength. Puts 3 Poison on the target.

glossary.name: Web
glossary.text: Deals 4 physical damage. Scales with Strength. A target with Slow loses Slow and gets 3 Daze. Any other target gets Slow for 2 turns.

glossary.name: Maul
glossary.text: Deals 14 physical damage. Scales with Strength. A target with Vulnerable loses Vulnerable and gets 3 Daze. Any other target gets Vulnerable for 1 turn.

glossary.name: Ember Bite
glossary.text: Deals 8 fire damage. Scales with Strength. Puts 2 Burn on the target.

glossary.name: Coin Spray
glossary.text: Hits every enemy. Each hit deals 6 physical damage. Scales with Strength. Each enemy hit gets Blind for 1 turn.

glossary.name: Gulp
glossary.text: Deals 10 physical damage. Scales with Strength. Puts 1 Bleed on the target. Takes one buff from the target. Gets Haste for 1 turn if the target had no buff.

glossary.name: Tombfall
glossary.text: Hits every enemy. Each hit deals 9 shadow damage. Scales with Magic.

glossary.name: Call of the Grave
glossary.text: Every enemy gets Fear for 2 turns. The user gets Inspire for 2 turns.

glossary.name: Burp
glossary.text: Hits every enemy. Each hit deals 6 physical damage. Scales with Strength. Each enemy hit gets 3 Poison.

glossary.name: Body Slam
glossary.text: Hits every enemy. Each hit deals 11 physical damage. Scales with Strength. Each enemy hit has a 25% chance to get 3 Daze.

glossary.name: Red Fire
glossary.text: Hits every enemy. Each hit deals 9 fire damage. Scales with Magic. Each enemy hit gets 2 Burn. After the user rises, hits twice.

glossary.name: Drain
glossary.text: Deals 12 shadow damage. Scales with Magic. The user heals for the damage dealt.

glossary.name: Call the Dead
glossary.text: The user's fallen Skeletons stand again at full HP. The user gets Inspire for 2 turns.

glossary.name: Shadow Step
glossary.text: Hits twice. Each hit deals 8 physical damage. Scales with Agility. Cannot be dodged. Each hit has a 50% chance to put 1 Bleed on the target.

glossary.name: Crossed Blades
glossary.text: Hits three times. Each hit deals 10 physical damage. Scales with Agility. +20% crit chance.

glossary.name: Shadow Copies
glossary.text: Hits every enemy. Each hit deals 9 physical damage. Scales with Agility. Each hit has a 50% chance to put 1 Bleed on the target.

glossary.name: Gale
glossary.text: Hits every enemy. Each hit deals 5 nature damage. Scales with Magic. Each target gets Slow for 1 turn.

glossary.name: Frost Bolt
glossary.text: Deals 8 nature damage. Scales with Magic. The target gets Chill for 2 turns.

glossary.name: Talons
glossary.text: Deals 12 physical damage. Scales with Strength. Puts 2 Bleed on the target.

glossary.name: Wing Gale
glossary.text: Hits every enemy. Each hit deals 5 physical damage. Scales with Strength. Each target gets Slow for 1 turn.

glossary.name: Quake
glossary.text: Hits every enemy. Each hit deals 10 physical damage. Scales with Strength. Each hit has a 25% chance to give the target 3 Daze.

glossary.name: Hurl
glossary.text: Deals 18 physical damage. Scales with Strength. The target gets 3 Daze.

glossary.name: Grasp
glossary.text: Deals 14 physical damage. Scales with Strength. The target gets 3 Daze.

glossary.name: Frost Breath
glossary.text: Hits every enemy. Each hit deals 7 physical damage. Scales with Strength. Each target gets Chill for 2 turns.

glossary.name: Call the Hunt
glossary.text: The user's fallen Snow Wolves stand again at full HP. The user gets Inspire for 2 turns.

glossary.name: Phoenix Flame
glossary.text: Hits every enemy. Each hit deals 7 fire damage. Scales with Magic. Each target gets 2 Burn.

glossary.name: Tide
glossary.text: Hits every enemy. Each hit deals 8 physical damage. Scales with Magic. Each target gets Vulnerable for 1 turn.

glossary.name: Ice Breath
glossary.text: Hits every enemy. Each hit deals 9 physical damage. Scales with Strength. Each target gets Chill for 2 turns and has a 25% chance to get Freeze for 1 turn.

glossary.name: Tail Lash
glossary.text: Deals 14 physical damage. Scales with Strength. Puts 2 Bleed on the target.

glossary.name: Bellow
glossary.text: Every enemy gets Fear for 2 turns. The user gets Inspire for 2 turns.

glossary.name: Antler Charge
glossary.text: Deals 24 physical damage. Scales with Strength. A target with Fear loses Fear and gets 3 Daze. Puts 2 Bleed on any other target.

glossary.name: Pounce
glossary.text: Deals 13 physical damage. Scales with Strength. The target gets Vulnerable for 2 turns.

glossary.name: Roar
glossary.text: Every enemy gets Fear for 1 turn. The user gets Inspire for 1 turn.

glossary.name: Peck
glossary.text: Deals 6 physical damage. Scales with Agility. Has a 40% chance to give the target Blind for 1 turn.

glossary.name: Last Moment
glossary.text: Deals 11 shadow damage. Scales with Magic. Has a 50% chance to give the target Fear for 1 turn.

glossary.name: Still the Hour
glossary.text: Deals 5 holy damage. Scales with Magic. The target gets Stilled for 1 turn. In the second phase it also strikes a second enemy.

glossary.name: Fall of Stone
glossary.text: Deals 18 physical damage. Scales with Strength. The target gets 3 Daze. In the second phase it also strikes a second enemy.

glossary.name: Royal Judgement
glossary.text: Deals 14 physical damage. Scales with Strength. The target gets Sunder for 2 turns and Vulnerable for 2 turns.

glossary.name: Rewind
glossary.text: The user gets back the HP it lost since the start of its last turn. First phase only.

glossary.name: Wake the Guard
glossary.text: Only while one of the user's guards is down: a fallen Kingsguard Spearman stands again at full HP.

glossary.name: Red Crossing
glossary.text: Hits twice, three times in the second phase. Each hit deals 8 physical damage. Scales with Agility. Each hit has a 50% chance to put 1 Bleed on the target.

glossary.name: A Finger from the Throat
glossary.text: Deals 20 physical damage. Scales with Agility. Cannot be dodged. +50% crit chance. In the second phase it also strikes a second enemy.

glossary.name: The Stopped Step
glossary.text: The user gets Haste for 2 turns.

glossary.name: Storm of Blades
glossary.text: Hits every enemy. Each hit deals 9 physical damage. Scales with Agility. Puts 1 Shock on each target.

glossary.name: Vow of Protection
glossary.text: An ally gets Guarded by you for 2 turns. You get Fortify for 1 turn. Costs 2 Energy.

glossary.name: Judgement
glossary.text: Deals {1} holy damage. Scales with Strength. Deals 30% more damage against a target with Oathbroken. The target gets Blind for 1 turn. Costs 3 Energy.

glossary.name: Contract
glossary.text: The target gets Contract for 3 turns. Does not end your turn. Costs 1 Energy.

glossary.name: Stance Shift
glossary.text: Takes Striking Stance, or swaps between Striking Stance and Guarding Stance. Gain 1 Energy. The first one in a fight does not end your turn.

glossary.name: Blood Frenzy
glossary.text: Costs 15% of your max HP. You get Frenzy for 3 turns.

glossary.name: Reckless Swing
glossary.text: Deals {1} physical damage. Scales with Strength. 1% more damage per 2% of max HP you are missing. You get Overextended for 1 turn. Costs 2 Energy.

glossary.name: Challenge
glossary.text: You and the target get Duel for 3 turns. The target can only attack you. You act again right away. Costs 1 Energy.

glossary.name: Riposte
glossary.text: You get 2 Counter. You get Riposte for 1 turn. Costs 2 Energy.

glossary.name: Mark for Death
glossary.text: The target gets Marked for 3 turns. The target gets Curse for 3 turns. You get Hidden for 1 turn. Costs 1 Energy.

glossary.name: Execute
glossary.text: Deals {1} physical damage. Scales with Agility. Deals 50% more damage against a target with Marked below 40% HP. If the target goes down, you get Hidden for 2 turns and gain 2 Energy. Costs 3 Energy.

glossary.name: Pocket Sand
glossary.text: The target gets Blind for 2 turns. 50% chance the target gets Silence for 1 turn. Costs 1 Energy.

glossary.name: Rob
glossary.text: Hits twice. Each hit deals {1} physical damage. Scales with Agility. Takes one buff from the target for you. You get Haste for 1 turn if the target had no buff. Costs 2 Energy.

glossary.name: Mend
glossary.text: Heals an ally for {1}. Scales with Magic. Ends one harmful status on the ally. Costs 2 Energy.

glossary.name: Smite
glossary.text: Deals {1} holy damage. Scales with Magic. The target gets Blind for 2 turns. Your ally with the lowest % HP heals for 30% of the damage. Costs 3 Energy.

glossary.name: Thornroot
glossary.text: Deals {1} nature damage. Scales with Magic. Puts 3 Poison on the target. The target gets Slow for 2 turns. Costs 2 Energy.

glossary.name: Wild Growth
glossary.text: You and every ally get Regen for 3 turns. Costs 2 Energy.

glossary.name: Ignite
glossary.text: Puts 2 Burn on every enemy. You get 1 Heat. Costs 2 Energy.

glossary.name: Detonate
glossary.text: Uses up the target's Burn. Deals {1} fire damage + {2} per Burn used up. Scales with Magic. Half of the Burn goes to the other enemies. Costs 3 Energy.

glossary.name: Shield Wall
glossary.text: You and every ally get Fortify for 2 turns. You get Rallying for 2 turns. Costs 2 Energy.

glossary.name: Vigil
glossary.text: You get Vigil for 1 turn. Each Vigil strike deals {1} physical damage. Scales with Strength. Costs 2 Energy.

glossary.name: Leap
glossary.text: Deals {1} physical damage. Scales with Strength. Also hits the enemy behind the target for 60% of the damage. Both get Sunder for 1 turn. Costs 2 Energy.

glossary.name: Skewer
glossary.text: Deals {1} physical damage. Scales with Strength. Deals 30% more damage against beasts and bosses. Puts 3 Bleed on the target. Costs 3 Energy.

glossary.name: Crowd Pleaser
glossary.text: Deals {1} physical damage. Scales with Strength. You get 1 Favor, 2 on a critical hit. Costs 2 Energy.

glossary.name: Spear Throw
glossary.text: Deals {1} physical damage. Scales with Strength. Uses up all your Favor. 10% more damage per Favor used up. The target gets 5 Daze if you used up 5 Favor. Costs 2 Energy.

glossary.name: Command
glossary.text: An ally or you acts once more right away. That action gives no Energy. Costs 3 Energy.

glossary.name: Decree
glossary.text: Deals {1} holy damage. Scales with Spirit. The target gets Sentenced for 2 turns. You and every ally get Decree for 2 turns. Ends one control status on each of you. Costs 2 Energy.

glossary.name: Verse
glossary.text: You and every ally heal for {1}. Scales with Spirit. Deals {2} shadow damage to a random enemy. You get 1 Verse. At 3 Verses, the next Verse is the Finale. The Finale uses up the Verses. Every ally gets Inspire and Regen for 2 turns. Costs 1 Energy. Once a round, a song for your allies does not end your turn.

glossary.name: Saga
glossary.text: Deals {1} shadow damage. Scales with Spirit. 20% more damage for each Verse you have. You get 1 Verse. You and every ally get Saga for 2 turns. You and every ally get Keen for 2 turns. Costs 1 Energy.

glossary.name: Mockery
glossary.text: Deals {1} shadow damage. Scales with Spirit. The target gets Taunted for 1 turn. The target gets Mocked for 1 turn. Costs 1 Energy.

glossary.name: Bag of Tricks
glossary.text: Deals {1} shadow damage. Scales with Spirit. Then one of five effects at random: the target gets 3 Daze; every ally gets Haste for 2 turns; every enemy gets Blind for 2 turns; the damage again; every ally heals for 10% of max HP. Costs 1 Energy.

glossary.name: Volley
glossary.text: Deals {1} physical damage to every enemy. Scales with Agility. Costs 3 Energy.

glossary.name: Steady Aim
glossary.text: You get Keen for 2 turns. You get Steady. Costs 1 Energy.

glossary.name: Call Hawk
glossary.text: A hawk joins the fight and acts after each of your turns. Each hawk hit deals {1} physical damage. Scales with Agility. Each hawk hit has a 50% chance to put 1 Bleed on the target. Costs 2 Energy.

glossary.name: Snare Trap
glossary.text: The target gets Snared. Costs 2 Energy.

glossary.name: Blast
glossary.text: Deals {1} physical damage. Scales with Agility. +50% crit damage. 15% chance to misfire. A misfire deals no damage and costs you 5% of your max HP. Costs 2 Energy.

glossary.name: Scattershot
glossary.text: Deals {1} fire damage to every enemy. Scales with Agility. Puts 1 Burn on every enemy hit. You lose 5% of your max HP. Costs 3 Energy.

glossary.name: Sovereign
glossary.text: Lawful 50 or more ahead of Chaotic.

glossary.name: Oathbound
glossary.text: Lawful 40 or more ahead of Chaotic.

glossary.name: Unbending
glossary.text: Lawful 30 or more ahead of Chaotic.

glossary.name: Lawbound
glossary.text: Lawful 20 or more ahead of Chaotic. Opens the Lawful Supers.

glossary.name: Dutiful
glossary.text: Lawful 10 or more ahead of Chaotic.

glossary.name: Neutral
glossary.text: Lawful and Chaotic less than 10 apart. Opens the Neutral Supers with both at 20 or more. An item that needs Neutral 20 needs Lawful and Chaotic at 20 or more together and less than 20 apart.

glossary.name: Unruly
glossary.text: Chaotic 10 or more ahead of Lawful.

glossary.name: Lawless
glossary.text: Chaotic 20 or more ahead of Lawful. Opens the Chaotic Supers.

glossary.name: Defiant
glossary.text: Chaotic 30 or more ahead of Lawful.

glossary.name: Unbound
glossary.text: Chaotic 40 or more ahead of Lawful.

glossary.name: Untamed
glossary.text: Chaotic 50 or more ahead of Lawful.

glossary.name: Physical damage
glossary.text: Armor reduces this damage. Status: Bleed.

glossary.name: Fire damage
glossary.text: Ward reduces this damage. Status: Burn. Ends Freeze. Reactions: Melt, Flashfire.

glossary.name: Frost damage
glossary.text: Ward reduces this damage. Statuses: Chill, Freeze.

glossary.name: Nature damage
glossary.text: Ward reduces this damage. Status: Poison.

glossary.name: Holy damage
glossary.text: Ward reduces this damage. Status: Blind. Reactions: Daybreak.

glossary.name: Shadow damage
glossary.text: Ward reduces this damage. Statuses: Curse, Fear.

glossary.name: Burn
glossary.text: Takes 3 fire damage, +1 per Burn, at the start of each turn. Then loses 1 Burn. The damage grows with the giver's level and status power. Up to 10 Burn.

glossary.name: Poison
glossary.text: Takes 1 nature damage, +1 per Poison, at the start of each turn. Then loses 1 Poison. 30% reduced healing received. The damage grows with the giver's level, weapon and status power. Up to 10 Poison. Reactions: Flashfire, Wither.

glossary.name: Bleed
glossary.text: Takes 1 physical damage, +1 per Bleed, on each Attack or skill used. Loses 1 Bleed at the end of each turn. The damage grows with the giver's level, weapon and status power. Up to 10 Bleed. Reactions: Rupture.

glossary.name: Chill
glossary.text: 8% chance per Chill to skip each turn. At 5 Chill, turns into Freeze.

glossary.name: Freeze
glossary.text: Skips the next turn. Takes 25% increased physical damage. Fire damage ends Freeze. Reactions: Melt, Shatter.

glossary.name: Shock
glossary.text: Takes 5% increased damage per Shock. Loses 1 Shock at the end of each turn. Up to 5 Shock.

glossary.name: Stun
glossary.text: Cannot act for 1 turn. Comes when Daze is full. Counts as Daze for what works against Daze.

glossary.name: Daze
glossary.text: Deals 3% less damage per Daze. At 5 Daze this fighter gets Stun for 1 turn and the Daze ends. Each Stun raises the Daze needed by 3 for the rest of the fight.

glossary.name: Asleep
glossary.text: Cannot act. Any damage ends Asleep. Hits against this enemy are critical hits. Hits against this enemy cannot be dodged or blocked.

glossary.name: Fear
glossary.text: Deals 20% less damage. No chance of extra Energy. Reactions: Panic.

glossary.name: Silence
glossary.text: Cannot use skills.

glossary.name: Blind
glossary.text: Hits have a 30% chance to miss. Reactions: Panic.

glossary.name: Slow
glossary.text: Cannot dodge or block.

glossary.name: Weak
glossary.text: Deals 25% less damage.

glossary.name: Sentenced
glossary.text: The first time this fighter uses a skill, it takes half the damage of the Decree that gave Sentenced and gets Silence for 1 turn. Then Sentenced ends.

glossary.name: Mocked
glossary.text: Its next hit on the fighter that gave Mocked is dodged. It takes 30% of that hit's damage itself. Then Mocked ends.

glossary.name: Vulnerable
glossary.text: Takes 25% increased damage. Reactions: Rupture, Unguarded.

glossary.name: Sunder
glossary.text: Armor is halved. Reactions: Rupture.

glossary.name: Curse
glossary.text: 50% reduced healing received. Reactions: Wither, Daybreak.

glossary.name: Marked
glossary.text: Attacks pick this enemy twice as often. Hits against this enemy have 25% more crit chance. Reactions: Unguarded.

glossary.name: Taunted
glossary.text: Can only attack the fighter that gave Taunted.

glossary.name: Fire Wall
glossary.text: Gets 5 Burn on each melee attack.

glossary.name: Regen
glossary.text: Heals 5% of max HP, +1, at the start of each turn. The healing grows with the giver's level.

glossary.name: Inspire
glossary.text: Deals 20% more damage.

glossary.name: Fortify
glossary.text: Takes 25% less damage.

glossary.name: Keen
glossary.text: 30% more crit chance. +20% crit damage.

glossary.name: Haste
glossary.text: The Attack hits twice.

glossary.name: Guarding
glossary.text: Blocks every hit until the next turn. +30% block power.

glossary.name: Shield
glossary.text: Each point stops 1 damage before HP. Loses 20% of the Shield at the start of each turn.

glossary.name: Thorns
glossary.text: Melee attackers take 1 true damage per Thorns. The damage grows with this fighter's level.

glossary.name: Counter
glossary.text: Strikes back with an Attack when hit by a melee attack. Then loses 1 Counter.

glossary.name: Hidden
glossary.text: Cannot be targeted by single-target attacks or skills while another fighter can be. Bosses can still target it. An attack or skill on an enemy ends Hidden, hit or miss. So does any damage this fighter deals.

glossary.name: Stilled
glossary.text: Held as stone: cannot act and takes 50% less damage.

glossary.name: Steadfast
glossary.text: Immune to Daze, Freeze and Asleep. Gained when Stun, Freeze or Asleep ends.

glossary.name: Unguarded
glossary.text: The next hit against this enemy is a critical hit. That hit cannot be dodged or blocked. Once a round on the same enemy.

glossary.name: Single-Wield
glossary.text: One one-handed weapon and an empty off-hand.

glossary.name: Dual-Wield
glossary.text: A one-handed weapon in each hand. Every hit uses the average Damage of both weapons. The lines and powers of both weapons count.

glossary.name: Two-Handed
glossary.text: A two-handed weapon. A bow with a quiver also counts as Two-Handed.

glossary.name: Guarded
glossary.text: Single-target attacks against this fighter hit the guard instead.

glossary.name: Sworn
glossary.text: Guards an ally.

glossary.name: Oathbroken
glossary.text: Attacked an ally a Knight guards. Judgement deals 30% more damage against this enemy.

glossary.name: Duel

glossary.name: Second Phase
glossary.text: The first hit that would take this enemy down leaves 50% of max HP instead. All harmful statuses end. Gets Inspire for 3 turns, Steadfast for 2 turns and 2 Energy.

glossary.name: Reckoning
glossary.text: Counts the skills used that cost Energy. The third is free.

glossary.name: Wraith
glossary.text: Attacks cannot pick this fighter. Takes no damage. Has 50% HP when Wraith ends.

glossary.name: Exile
glossary.text: 5% more damage.

glossary.name: Acolyte
glossary.text: 10% more healing done.

glossary.name: Hunter
glossary.text: 10% more damage with Status Effects.

glossary.name: Scholar
glossary.text: +1 max Energy.

glossary.name: Seraph
glossary.text: A Priest Ultra. Gives Sheltering Wing and Dawnfall at level 40. Gives Feather Storm at level 50.

glossary.name: Oracle
glossary.text: A Priest Ultra. Gives Foretell and Unwritten at level 40. Gives Doom at level 50.

glossary.name: Zealot
glossary.text: A Priest Ultra. Gives Searing Brand and Pillar of Fire at level 40. Gives Kindle at level 50.

glossary.name: Ultra skill
glossary.text: Needs your Energy full and uses all of it. 8% more power for each Energy past 6. Once a fight. Takes Ultra Skill Gems only.

glossary.name: Sheltering Wing
glossary.text: Heals an ally for {1}. Scales with Magic. The ally gets a Shield of 10% of your max HP. Costs 2 Energy.

glossary.name: Feather Storm
glossary.text: Deals {1} holy damage to every enemy. Scales with Magic. 30% more damage for each Feather you have. Uses up your Feathers. Every enemy gets Blind for 1 turn. Costs 2 Energy.

glossary.name: Dawnfall
glossary.text: Ultra skill. Deals {1} holy damage to every enemy. Scales with Magic. Every ally heals 35% of its max HP and loses its harmful statuses. Every fallen ally stands up with 30% of its max HP.

glossary.name: Foretell
glossary.text: An ally gets Foretold for 2 turns. Costs 2 Energy.

glossary.name: Doom
glossary.text: An enemy gets Doomed for 2 turns. When it ends, the enemy takes {1} holy damage. Scales with Magic. Costs 2 Energy.

glossary.name: Unwritten
glossary.text: Ultra skill. Every ally goes back to the HP it had when its last turn began. A fallen ally stands up with that HP. Every ally gets Foretold. Every enemy gets Doomed for 1 turn, then takes {1} holy damage. Scales with Magic.

glossary.name: Searing Brand
glossary.text: Deals {1} holy damage. Scales with Magic. The target gets Branded for 3 turns. Costs 2 Energy.

glossary.name: Kindle
glossary.text: Costs 12% of your max HP. You gain 2 Energy and get Fervent. You act again, once a round.

glossary.name: Pillar of Fire
glossary.text: Ultra skill. Deals {1} holy damage. Scales with Magic. 50% more damage against Branded enemies. You heal for 30% of the damage.

glossary.name: Feathers
glossary.text: 5% more healing done and 5% increased holy damage per Feather. Up to 5 Feathers.

glossary.name: Foretold
glossary.text: The next hit is a critical hit and cannot be dodged.

glossary.name: Doomed
glossary.text: When Doomed ends, takes the holy damage of the Doom that gave it.

glossary.name: Branded
glossary.text: Takes holy damage when the Zealot who branded it heals.

glossary.name: Fervent
glossary.text: The next skill with a holy hit deals 30% more damage.

glossary.name: Wings of Light
glossary.text: Each of your skills that heals gives you 1 Feather.

glossary.name: Prophecy
glossary.text: Each Foretold hit and each Doom that comes true gives you 1 Energy. A Doomed enemy that falls first counts too.

glossary.name: Zeal
glossary.text: When you heal an ally or yourself, every enemy you Branded takes holy damage equal to 40% of the HP healed.

glossary.name: Head Start
glossary.text: The fight starts with your Energy full.

glossary.name: Defiance
glossary.text: With your Energy full, a blow that would down you leaves you at 1 HP, and the Ultra skill goes off at once at the one who struck. Once a fight.

glossary.name: Build Up
glossary.text: 10% more power for each of your turns that starts with your Energy full, until the skill is used.

glossary.name: Sacrifice
glossary.text: The skill also costs 30% of your max HP. Never your last HP.

glossary.name: Uplift
glossary.text: After the skill, you and every ally gain 3 Energy.

glossary.name: Humanoid Study
glossary.text: From your guild's Bestiary. 1% more damage against Humanoids for each rank.

glossary.name: Beast Study
glossary.text: From your guild's Bestiary. 1% more damage against Beasts for each rank.

glossary.name: Undead Study
glossary.text: From your guild's Bestiary. 1% more damage against Undead for each rank.

glossary.name: Spirit Study
glossary.text: From your guild's Bestiary. 1% more damage against Spirits for each rank.
